SELECT TOP 50000
    source_id,
    ra,
    dec,
    phot_g_mean_mag,
    bp_rp,
    parallax,
    parallax_over_error
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE (non_single_star IS NULL OR non_single_star = 0)
  AND parallax_over_error > 5
  AND parallax > 0.01
  AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
  AND MOD(source_id, 36000) = 0
